question: In which Indian state is the 'International Lusophone Festival' hosted?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Goa**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The International Lusophone Festival will be held in Goa from 3-6 December.
 
• It will be inaugurated by the Chief Minister of Goa, Pramod Sawant in Raj Bhavan.
 
• It is organized by the Ministry of External Affairs (MEA) in partnership with the Indian Council of Cultural Relations (ICCR) and the Goa govt.
 
• Lusophones are people that speak Portuguese as a native or as a common second language.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ​The Ministry of External Affairs of India is the government agency responsible for implementing Indian foreign policy.
 
• Subrahmanyam Jaishankar is an Indian diplomat and politician serving as the Minister of External Affairs of the Government of India since 30 May 2019.
 
• The Indian Council for Cultural Relations is an autonomous organization of the Government of India, involved in India's global cultural relations, through cultural exchange with other countries and their people.
 
 
• President: Vinay Sahasrabuddhe
